parsed.post: Discarding the increase in MATRIX_LR to 0.06; it raised BPB from 0.8477 to 0.8556. The deeper model seems sensitive to higher learning rates within the 5-minute window. Reverting to LR=0.05. Next: I'll try halving the TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to see if more optimization steps help convergence with DEPTH=8.
parsed.description: Reverting MATRIX_LR to 0.05 and reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase step count.
